verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a distinct transactional email channel, with an API for automated emails such as order confirmations and password resets, transactional-specific event exports, and a transactional sandbox mode. This suggests transactional sending is a separate stream from marketing campaigns, but nothing in the evidence shows it actually keeps suppression, templates, or reputation separate. missing for 10: evidence of separate transactional suppression rules, delivery to unsubscribed marketing contacts, separate templates, dedicated reputation or IP isolation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact

citations.quote: Send order confirmations, password resets, and other automated emails to your users.
Export raw data of all transactional events from the past 7 days.
Test transactional emails without sending them using sandbox mode
